program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((code (at g 0 0)))
    (define (apply-cmd grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (rotate-ccw grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 6) (flip-ud grid)]
            [else (transpose grid)]))
    (define (after-two xs) (rest (rest xs)))
    (define (lookup v pairs)
      (cond [(empty? pairs) #f]
            [(= v (first (first pairs))) (second (first pairs))]
            [else (lookup v (rest pairs))]))
    (define src (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (after-two (row g 0))))
    (define tgt (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (after-two (row g 1))))
    (define mapping (map list src tgt))
    (define obj (crop-to-content (subgrid g 2 0 (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1))))
    (define remapped
      (grid-from-fn (rows obj) (cols obj)
        (lambda (r c)
          (let* ((v (at obj r c))
                 (hit (lookup v mapping)))
            (if (and (not (= v 0)) hit) hit v)))))
    (crop-to-content (apply-cmd remapped code))))
